/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [Bronze].[usp_load_cetas_partition]    Script Date: 18/02/2026 00:36:58 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER   PROCEDURE [Bronze].[usp_load_cetas_partition]
(
    @SourceConnectionName NVARCHAR(200),
    @TableName NVARCHAR(200),
    @PrimaryKey NVARCHAR(200),
    @ColumnList NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @ColumnTypeList NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @WatermarkTS DATETIME = NULL,
	@DetectDeletes int = NULL
)
AS

BEGIN

DECLARE @RunId NVARCHAR(20) = REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(36),NEWID()),'-','');

DECLARE @LoadDate DATE = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);
DECLARE @LoadDateString NVARCHAR(10) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@LoadDate,120);

DECLARE @PartitionLocation NVARCHAR(MAX) =
    '/' + @SourceConnectionName + '/' + @TableName + '/loaddate=' + @LoadDateString + '/';

DECLARE @ExternalTableName NVARCHAR(MAX) =
    'Bronze.' + @SourceConnectionName + '_' + @TableName + '_' + REPLACE(@LoadDateString,'-','_') + '_' + @RunId;

SET @PrimaryKey = QUOTENAME(@PrimaryKey);

--//==========================
--	HashCompare - Vergelijkt oude stand Bronze met nieuwe records landing zone en retourneert alleen afwijkingen
--	Optioneel in @SQL: Ja
--//==========================

DECLARE @HashCompare NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
IF @WatermarkTS IS NOT NULL
SET @HashCompare =
'
LEFT JOIN bronze.vw_' + @SourceConnectionName + '_' + @TableName + ' tgt
    ON hashed.'+@PrimaryKey+' = tgt.'+@PrimaryKey+'
WHERE tgt.'+@PrimaryKey+' IS NULL
   OR hashed.row_hash <> tgt.row_hash
';

--//==========================
-- DeleteCompare - Vergelijkt de window (of full load) en markeert regels voor verwijdering door deze opnieuw in te laden en IsDeleted 1 mee te geven
-- Optioneel in @SQL: Ja
--//==========================
DECLARE @DeleteCompare NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
IF @DetectDeletes IS NOT NULL
SET @DeleteCompare = N'
UNION ALL
SELECT
        ' + replace(@ColumnTypeList, @PrimaryKey,'lz.'+@PrimaryKey) +' ,
        LoadDate,
        row_hash,
        bronze_watermark,
        1 AS IsDeleted
FROM bronze.vw_'+  @SourceConnectionName +'_'+@TableName+' tgt
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT '+@PrimaryKey+'
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK '''+ @PartitionLocation + '*.parquet'',
        DATA_SOURCE = ''landingzone'',
        FORMAT = ''PARQUET''
    ) as src
) as lz
ON tgt.'+@PrimaryKey+' = lz.'+@PrimaryKey+'
WHERE lz.'+@PrimaryKey+' IS NULL
  AND tgt.IsDeleted = 0
';


--//==========================
-- Opbouwen - SQL Query @SQL
-- 1. Maak temp external table aan om data naar de juiste loaddate folder te schrijven
-- 2. Laad nieuwe content vanuit landingzone en voeg metadata kolommen toe in volgorde
--      - LoadDate
--      - row_hash
--      - bronze_watermark
--		- IsDeleted
--//==========================
DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX) =
'
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ' + @ExternalTableName + '
WITH
(
    LOCATION = ''' + @PartitionLocation + ''',
    DATA_SOURCE = bronze,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
)
AS
SELECT hashed.*
FROM
(
    SELECT
        ' + @ColumnTypeList + ',
        '''+@LoadDateString+''' AS loaddate,
        HASHBYTES(''SHA2_256'', CONCAT_WS(''|'','+@ColumnList+')) AS row_hash,
        GETDATE() AS bronze_watermark,
        NULL AS IsDeleted
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK ''' + @PartitionLocation + '*.parquet'',
        DATA_SOURCE = ''landingzone'',
        FORMAT = ''PARQUET''
    ) lz
) hashed
' + @HashCompare + '
' + @DeleteCompare +'
';

--//==========================
-- Aanroepen - SQL Query
 print @SQL; -- Stuur query terug voor debuggen
--//==========================
BEGIN TRY
    EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    PRINT ERROR_MESSAGE();
END CATCH

IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sys.external_tables
    WHERE name = PARSENAME(@ExternalTableName,1)
)
    EXEC('DROP EXTERNAL TABLE ' + @ExternalTableName);
